title: Spotify playlist dialog offers Try again where retry cannot help
acceptance: Identify each unretryable playlist error and its actionable recovery.
Retryable playlist errors keep Try again; unretryable ones show their reason with no Try again, and a reconnect error offers Manage connections.

evidence.summary: Original board entry; historical assertion, not independently verified product behavior.

Owner decision in session on 2026-10-28: Spotify work is reopened (the family now has Spotify Family). The Apple Music subscription ends around 2026-11-27, so Apple hardening and Apple device checks come first in that window.
Owner-approved phased plan (2026-10-29) groups RF-74 under RF-92 in Phase 3 (Spotify).

Read-only on main b22ec04c, 2026-11-13: classifyPlaylistDrillInError keeps retry off the drill-in for PROVIDER_FORBIDDEN, PROVIDER_QUOTA_EXCEEDED and reauth; the playlist index (savedPlaylists === null branch) and search-mode error row still render Try again for PROVIDER_QUOTA_EXCEEDED. Not run in a browser.

Mapping: PROVIDER_FORBIDDEN and PROVIDER_QUOTA_EXCEEDED show their sentence with no retry; REAUTH_REQUIRED/NOT_CONNECTED offer Manage connections; SPOTIFY_DEVELOPMENT_MODE keeps Try again because its sentence says to retry once the account is allowlisted; timeouts, 5xx and others keep Try again. Music tab PlaylistBrowserDialog and the builder saved-playlist index now follow it (the builder drill-in already did). Dashboard and TrackSearch tests cover each kind; 4 of the new tests fail on the old components. jsdom with mocked API only: not checked in a browser against real Spotify errors.

resolution: The Music tab playlist dialog and the builder saved-playlist index offer Try again only for failures a retry can fix; forbidden and quota show their reason, and reauth offers Manage connections (#764). Catalog search has the same quota gap and moved to RF-219.
